SELECT sku.commodity_store_sku_id AS skuId, sku.commodity_store_sku_name AS skuName, sku.commodity_store_sku_price AS skuPrice, sku.commodity_store_sku_strike_price AS strikeThroughPrice, sku.sku_id AS originalSkuId,
-- category.commodity_store_category_name AS categoryName, spu.category_name AS categoryName,
spu.commodity_id AS commodityId, spu.commodity_store_category_id AS categoryId, spu.commodity_store_spu_id AS spuId, spu.commodity_store_spu_name AS spuName, spu.commodity_store_spu_description AS spuDesc, spu.setmeal_type AS setmealType, spu.image_url AS imageUrl, spu.many_copy AS manyCopy, spu.package_fee AS packageFee, spu.condiments AS condiments, spu.sale_rule AS saleRule, spu.limit_buy_number AS limitBuyNumber, spu.condiment_is_more AS condimentIsMore, spu.max_condiment_number AS maxCondimentNumber, spu.time_sharing_topping AS timeSharingTopping, spu.start_date AS startDate, spu.end_date AS endDate, spu.day_numbers AS dayNumbers, spu.week_numbers AS weekNumbers, spu.is_all_day AS isAllDay, spu.time_range AS timeRange, spu.commodity_store_spu_machine_status AS commodityStoreSpuMachineStatus, spu.commodity_store_spu_applet_status AS commodityStoreSpuAppletStatus, spu.commodity_store_spu_detail_url AS noDeliveryForSingleOrder FROM commodity_store_sku sku LEFT JOIN commodity_store_spu spu ON sku.commodity_store_spu_id = spu.commodity_store_spu_id -- LEFT JOIN commodity_store_category category ON spu.commodity_store_category_id = category.commodity_store_category_id WHERE sku.deleted = 0 AND spu.deleted = 0 AND sku.commodity_store_sku_id IN
#{storeSkuId}

SELECT sku.commodity_store_sku_id AS skuId, sku.commodity_store_sku_name AS skuName, sku.commodity_store_sku_price AS skuPrice, sku.commodity_store_sku_strike_price AS strikeThroughPrice, sku.sku_id AS originalSkuId,
-- category.commodity_store_category_name AS categoryName, spu.category_name AS categoryName,
spu.commodity_id AS commodityId, spu.commodity_store_category_id AS categoryId, spu.commodity_store_spu_id AS spuId, spu.commodity_store_spu_name AS spuName, spu.commodity_store_spu_description AS spuDesc, spu.setmeal_type AS setmealType, spu.image_url AS imageUrl, spu.many_copy AS manyCopy, spu.package_fee AS packageFee, spu.sale_rule AS saleRule, spu.time_sharing_topping AS timeSharingTopping, spu.start_date AS startDate, spu.end_date AS endDate, spu.day_numbers AS dayNumbers, spu.week_numbers AS weekNumbers, spu.is_all_day AS isAllDay, spu.time_range AS timeRange, spu.commodity_store_spu_machine_status AS commodityStoreSpuMachineStatus, spu.commodity_store_spu_applet_status AS commodityStoreSpuAppletStatus FROM commodity_store_sku sku JOIN commodity_store_spu spu ON sku.commodity_store_spu_id = spu.commodity_store_spu_id -- LEFT JOIN commodity_store_category category ON spu.commodity_store_category_id = category.commodity_store_category_id WHERE sku.deleted = 0 AND spu.deleted = 0 AND sku.store_id = #{storeId} AND sku.commodity_store_sku_status = 1 -- 分组可选套餐不能作为满赠赠品；NULL按普通单品处理。 AND IFNULL(spu.setmeal_type, 0) != 2 -- 有小料配置的单品不能作为赠品。condiments为JSON文本，在SQL中过滤，不查询到应用层判断。 -- NULL、空字符串、空数组[]、空对象{}视为无小料；非空非法JSON按有配置处理，避免脏数据误赠。 AND IF( spu.condiments IS NULL OR TRIM(spu.condiments) = '', 0, IF(JSON_VALID(spu.condiments), IFNULL(JSON_LENGTH(spu.condiments), 0), 1) ) = 0 AND spu.commodity_id IN
#{commodityId}
